generator.description: a pseudorandom number generator for sampling

out.description: the output tensor. dtype (:class:`torch.dtype`, optional): the desired data type of returned tensor. Default: ``torch.int64``.

layout.description: the desired layout of returned Tensor. Default: ``torch.strided``.

device.description: the desired device of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, uses the current device for the default tensor type (see :func:`torch.set_default_device`). :attr:`device` will be the CPU for CPU tensor types and the current CUDA device for CUDA tensor types.

requires_grad.description: If autograd should record operations on the returned tensor. Default: ``False``.

pin_memory.description: If set, returned tensor would be allocated in the pinned memory. Works only for CPU tensors. Default: ``False``.
